technique_name: Design an experiment to collect data on the impact of social media on people's mental health.
description: The aim of the experiment would be to collect data on the impact of social media on people's mental health. The experiment would involve recruiting a sample of participants, ideally containing people of diverse backgrounds. Each participant would complete a survey, which would gather data on the amount of time they spend using social media each week, as well as any mental health problems that they have.
